exam: 115年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員考試、115年公務人員特種考試國際經濟商務人員考試、115年公務人員特種考試民航人員考試、115年公務人員特種考試原住民族考試
subject: 外交實務英文寫作(以英文命題及作答)
classes: 外交領事人員類科英文組二

essays.text: The International Criminal Court issuing arrest warrants for sitting nationalleaders has highlighted acute legal conflict over Rome Statute enforcementobligations versus traditional head-of-state diplomatic immunity. Draft anofficial commentary of about 350 words, assessing the tension betweeninternational legal accountability for war crimes and pragmatic foreignrelations, and state Taiwan’s position. (25 points)

European governments and major cultural institutions face growingdiplomatic demands to repatriate colonial-era artifacts to their countries oforigin, sparking ethical debates over heritage ownership. Draft an officialcommentary of about 350 words, analyzing the core ethical argumentssurrounding cultural restitution, and discuss how Taiwan can utilize itsmuseum collections to foster ethical cultural diplomacy. (25 points)

North Korea has been reported to have supplied ballistic missiles and artilleryshells to Russia for use in Ukraine, violating multiple UN Security Councilresolutions. Draft an official commentary of about 350 words, weighing thesecurity implications of these illegal arms transfers and potential approachesto independent international oversight, and state how Taiwan can contributeto regional and global security efforts. (25 points)

Faced with persistent migration surges, several Western democracies haveproposed outsourcing asylum processing to third-party countries, raisingintense debates over the non-refoulement principle under the 1951 RefugeeConvention. Draft an official commentary of about 350 words, evaluating thelegal and humanitarian friction surrounding third-country processing, andstate Taiwan’s posture on humanitarian asylum policies. (25 points)
